notes: Episodes 490-498 had no dated neighbours after 408; all dated from on-air cues as Tuesdays 30 Jul - 15 Oct 1991 (19 Av 5751 - 7 Cheshvan 5752): 491 'this Shabbos is Rosh Chodesh Elul' (30 Av on Shabbos = 5751), 495 Erev Rosh Hashanah on Sunday, 496 aired on Erev Yom Kippur, plus candle times. No shows on 10 Sep (Rosh Hashanah), 24 Sep and 1 Oct (Yom Tov).

Many segments are re-airs: Elul talk 490 = ep. 391; Simcha talk 491 = ep. 138; 'Reward for Kindness' 493 = eps. 140 and 403; Rosh Hashanah talk 495 partially overlaps eps. 143 and 193. Candidate 'Rosh Hashana 193' clip (b6edf12c13) not linked; check whether it is the same talk as 'Rosh Hashana 495'.
Ep. 497's Shema segment seems to be the same recording as ep. 494 (same guest, same dialogue), reused.
Same child: letter writer in ep. 497 (mailbox, home address read on air) is the Shema guest with his family in ep. 498.
Teacher 'Morah Lazar' with the Beis Yaakov of Boro Park third grade appears in ep. 493 (also in ep. 408); a different teacher 'Morah Lazarov' (Beis Rivkah) is named in ep. 495.
Guest musician 'Reb Nature' (Reb Dovid Lazerson) with a fiddler performs songs in eps. 491 and 492; treated as a public performer, not hidden.
Master catalog row 491 is Hebrew ('Shelo asani goy', topic 'Reb nature'); row 497 'Kibbud Av Voaim' is the Dama ben Nesina story; titled from content.
Ep. 496 states two different fast start times (6:58 and 6:50). Ep. 494 gives Shabbos end 8:23 against candle lighting 7:13 (likely slip).
Ep. 498 siblings' names are garbled by ASR; recorded 'as heard' in hidden.
